verdict.rationale: First-party docs say AssemblyAI handles live audio over WebSocket at about 150ms p50 latency for live captions and voice agents. A dedicated Universal Streaming page notes the SDK manages the WebSocket connection and session termination, and the SDKs and voice-agent framework integrations (LiveKit, Pipecat, Twilio) cover streaming. The 2018 community comment asking for real-time dictation is an old feature request, not a hands-on failure, so it does not contradict the current docs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of streaming in practice, and documented raw WebSocket protocol details (message formats, auth, partial/final transcript events) in the evidence.
